notes.text: Bug fix: Import errors now show each distinct message once instead of repeating it.
Feature: The Position Board map picker lists every available map and marks maps that still need an image as placeholders.
Feature: A draft or comp can now use several maps or a whole game mode.

Feature: Cradle: Krakoa (Domination), Central Park, Hall of Djalia, Heart of Heaven, Lower Manhattan, Shin-Shibuya and Symbiotic Surface (Convergence), and Arakko, Midtown, Thebes, Yggdrasill Path and Spider-Islands (Convoy) are now available as Position Board maps.
Bug fix: Choosing the same Deadpool again no longer marks a saved comp as unsaved.
Bug fix: A map stops at 2,000 drawings, so a later reload keeps the board.
Feature: Drag a handle on a selected arrow, zone, or note to resize it.
Bug fix: The browser tab title now names the current page.
Bug fix: Unknown URLs now show a not-found page, and known pages open from any capitalization.
Bug fix: The builder heading reads "Bans and Saves", a single-hero team keeps a normal card size in the downloaded comp image, and the Changelog shows one entry per date.
Bug fix: Hero search now finds names typed without hyphens or spaces, such as "spiderman", and matches roles like "duelist".
Feature: Choose a comp map from its image and see its name once below it.
Feature: Back up your comps, board, and custom maps to one file with Backup, and restore them in another browser.
Bug fix: Add and remove buttons beside hero portraits on the Position Board are smaller.
Feature: Upload your own map images from Choose map on the Position Board.
Feature: Plan and save comps for The God Quarry Domination map.
Feature: Preview the selected map in the Draft / Comp Builder.
Feature: Read dated updates for deployed features on the Changelog page.
Feature: Select maps by preview and search, or close the picker with its X button.
Bug fix: Change the map of a comp and keep its draft bans and saves.
Feature: See features and bug fixes labeled in the Changelog.
Feature: First recorded release. Place heroes on maps and draw positions and rotations with undo and redo.
Feature: Build and save team comps. Import and export saved comps, download comp images, and open comps on the Position Board.
